brand.name: Pawly
brand.description: A visual identity that inspires hygiene and competence. "Vet Teal" reassures, Black/White structures, Orange humanizes.

logotype.authorizedDesc: Use the logo in Black (#171717) on a white background for maximum readability. The white version on "Vet Teal" background is accepted for strong branding.
logotype.forbiddenDesc: Do not use gradients on the logo. It must remain flat and clinical.

typography.bodyDescription: Pawly simplifies life for veterinary clinics. A clean sans-serif typography (Inter) ensures perfect readability of medical records.
typography.medicalClarityDesc: Avoid decorative fonts. Everything must be instantly readable.
typography.colorHierarchyDesc: Titles in Black, Paragraphs in Neutral Gray, Medical labels in Vet Teal.

texture.description: The Pawly interface breathes clinical cleanliness without being cold. White dominates, enhanced by soft colored shadows that indicate interactivity.

iconography.colorsRuleDesc: Dark gray (Neutral-900) by default. Vet Teal (#009588) is used to emphasize the medical/care aspect.

meta.title: Pawly — Intelligent Planning for Veterinary Clinics
meta.description: Simplify your veterinary clinic management with Pawly. Intelligent scheduling, team coordination, and subscription management in one platform.

hero.title: Intelligent planning for your veterinary clinic
hero.subtitle: Pawly streamlines scheduling, team management, and daily operations — so you can focus on what matters most: animal care.

features.title: Everything your clinic needs
features.subtitle: Powerful tools designed specifically for veterinary practice management.

scheduling.title: Smart Scheduling
scheduling.description: Automated shift planning with constraint-based algorithms. Handle surgeries, consultations, and rest periods effortlessly.

team.title: Team Management
team.description: Manage veterinarians, ASVs, and apprentices with role-based access. Track contracts, absences, and equity counters.

billing.title: Subscription & Billing
billing.description: Transparent pricing with Stripe-powered billing. Manage your subscription, view invoices, and control costs.

mobile.title: Mobile Ready
mobile.description: Progressive Web App for your team. Employees can check schedules, request absences, and confirm presence from any device.

i18n.title: Bilingual Support
i18n.description: Full French and English support. Every screen, notification, and report is available in both languages.

security.title: Secure & Reliable
security.description: Magic link authentication, JWT tokens, and role-based access control. Your clinic data is protected at every level.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your clinic. All plans include a free trial.

starter.description: Perfect for small clinics getting started
